test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who possesses outstanding technical ability in a particular art or field
solution: The correct answer is **"Virtuoso."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • A **"virtuoso"** is someone who possesses outstanding technical ability in a particular art or field. (किसी कला में (विशेषतः वाद्य यंत्र संगीत कला में) अति दक्ष, कलाविज्ञ, कला-प्रवीण) • **Example**: *He is a **virtuoso**__ pianist who can play complex pieces with ease.* • The word** "virtuoso"** is a noun. • It is pronounced as **"vur-choo-oh-soh."** • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (Virtuous) **means having high moral standards or being morally upright. (सदाचारी, सद्‌गुणी, गुणवान) • **Option 3 (Gourmand) **means a person who enjoys eating and often eats too much. (खाने में और ख़ूब खाने में रुचि रखने वाला व्‍यक्ति; भोजनभट्ट, पेटू) • **Option 4 (Amateur) **means a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis. (शौक़िया, अव्‍यवसायी) 47:Te6d, The correct answer is** "approved."**
